info.name: BestKid Marketplace API (Simple)
info.description: Lightweight Postman collection covering the main endpoints of the bestkid-multivendor-marketplace backend, grouped by module. No global route prefix. Auth: Bearer JWT via {{accessToken}} (collection-level), admin-only routes use {{adminAccessToken}}. Public routes are marked no-auth.
